title: GCN and graph attention

paper.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement GCN and graph attention: implement normalized graph convolution and attention on Cora; aspirational node accuracy 0.81 on a declared split. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use cora; required output: Node features and graph -> node logits. Evaluate node_accuracy (maximize). Declare transductive graph use and fixed public label masks. Required ablation: Replace attention with degree normalization at matched hidden width. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
